text:
elaine: Heads-up: new Private/on-prem policy change going live for GA customers. We're moving to enforced cert rotation (90-day max) and reducing CRL/ocsp retention to 30 days to align with several enterprise audits. Details in the policy doc: https://internal.redwood.io/policy/onprem-cert-rotation
product-bot: Doc published: ONPREM-CERT-ROTATION-POLICY v1.0 by elaine — 1780405555
vik: Can we get a quick summary for customers? wording needs to be non-technical for legal and procurement.
elaine: Short TL;DR (customer-facing): "Certificates must be rotated at most every 90 days. Automatic rotation is available; customers may manage keys via BYOK with approved HSMs." I'll produce a one-paragraph summary.
own: Ops question: how will auto-rotation affect long-running KV caches and active sessions? Need a graceful rekey plan.
bryce: Plan: rotation happens on a rolling basis per node. We added an in-memory dual-key acceptance window of 10 minutes during rotation so sessions don't drop. Ops playbook has the exact flow.
own: Will add a readiness check to the installer that validates cert expiry < 90 days and flags nodes needing rotation. Example CLI: `./rwctl cert status --threshold 90`
nora: Security note: BYOK customers must provide an HSM attestation and a signed POA (proof-of-possession) before we allow external keys. We'll capture that via intake form and an initial validation run.
security-bot: Policy rule added: BYOK_REQUIRE_ATTESTATION = true — enforcement scheduled 2026-04-07
vik: Compliance ask: CRL/OCSP retention shorter window — do we keep hashes/anchors longer for audit? Customers ask for evidence beyond 30 days.
elaine: We will keep signed audit transcripts (hashes + timestamps) for 1 year in an append-only ledger stored in customer's vault, but live CRL/OCSP blobs expire at 30 days. This balances auditability with data-minimization.
bryce: Implementation detail: ledger entries are only metadata (hashes + issuer + timestamp) and do not contain private material. We included export hooks so customers can pull the ledger to their SIEM.
vik: Great. Also, what about emergency rollback for cert rotations gone wrong?
own: Rollback command in playbook: `./rwctl cert rollback --to-serial 0x4F2A --force` — documented with prechecks. Ops-runbooks have a mandatory dry-run step.
nora: Legal reminder: EU customers must explicitly opt into remote rotation (we cannot force remote key ops across borders). Add explicit checkbox during enablement.
elaine: Noted — legal copy updated and product will surface the checkbox during onboarding.
security-bot: Automation: created ticket TEMPLATE-SEC-ROT-01 to track BYOK attestations and rotation status per customer.
bryce: SRE note: we'll monitor rotation latency metric and set alert if it exceeds 2x baseline. Dashboard tile added to Console.
vik: Training ask: can we run a 20-min field eng workshop on the rotation flow and rollback next Tue?
elaine: Scheduled: Tue 11:00 PT. Invite to follow. Please review the policy doc and the playbook before the session.
own: I'll open a small PR to add the readiness check to the preflight.
elaine: Thanks all 680 flag any blockers here."
